svg.text: Mandala String Art XY Plotter — Wiring Diagram
ESP32 DevKit V1 · A4988 ×2–4 · NEMA17 · SSD1306 OLED · servo or Z stepper · firmware v1.2.0 · woodyouloveit
ESP32 pins are grouped by function, not by their physical order on the board
one side → GND · hold START 2 s = resume saved job
+12V after E-STOP → VMOT of every A4988
1 All GND points are one common ground (supply, buck, ESP32, drivers, OLED, servo).
2 Set A4988 current before connecting motors: Vref = 8 × I × Rs. R100 boards (Rs 0.1 Ω):
Vref 0.8 V ≈ 1.0 A. Fit heatsinks. Never unplug a motor while powered.
3 100 µF ≥25 V electrolytic across VMOT–GND right at every driver (drawn next to VMOT).
4 Two Y motors without y_dual: wire the 2nd driver's STEP/DIR to GPIO25/33 too
and reverse that motor by swapping its 2A/2B wires.
5 No limit switches fitted: send $hard_limits=0 and $homing_enable=0.
